email_templates.name: New Order Notification
email_templates.subject: New Order #[order_id] Registered
email_templates.body:
Dear [client_name],

Your order #[order_id] has been registered on the portal.

Order Type: [order_type] | Quantity: [qty] | PO: [po_no]

Deadline: [deadline_date]

Please log in to your dashboard to review status.

Regards,
ISS Team
email_templates.variables: order_id, client_name, order_type, qty, po_no, deadline_date, receiver_name, courier_id, stage_number, buffer_time, completion_time

email_templates.name: Stage 1 Completed
email_templates.subject: Order #[order_id] - Stage 1 (Delivery Challan) Completed
email_templates.body:
Hello Accounts Department,

Stage 1 has been completed for order #[order_id]. Received by: [receiver_name].

Invoice uploading is now pending for your action.
email_templates.variables: order_id, client_name, order_type, qty, po_no, deadline_date, receiver_name, courier_id, stage_number, buffer_time, completion_time

email_templates.name: Stage 2 Completed
email_templates.subject: Order #[order_id] - Stage 2 (Invoice) Completed
email_templates.body:
Hello Logistics Department,

Stage 2 has been completed for order #[order_id].

Courier dispatch registration is now pending for your action.
email_templates.variables: order_id, client_name, order_type, qty, po_no, deadline_date, receiver_name, courier_id, stage_number, buffer_time, completion_time

email_templates.name: Order Completed
email_templates.subject: Order #[order_id] Completed & Dispatched
email_templates.body:
Dear client [client_name],

Your order #[order_id] is now fully complete.

Courier tracking ID: [courier_id].
email_templates.variables: order_id, client_name, order_type, qty, po_no, deadline_date, receiver_name, courier_id, stage_number, buffer_time, completion_time

email_templates.name: Task Reupload Request
email_templates.subject: Reupload Required for Order #[order_id]
email_templates.body:
Hello,

A reupload request has been generated for order #[order_id].

Please upload the corrected documents within the portal before the buffer timer expires.
email_templates.variables: order_id, client_name, order_type, qty, po_no, deadline_date, receiver_name, courier_id, stage_number, buffer_time, completion_time
